Hi Evan / GlobalShip team,

We're starting a Q4 peripheral refresh: docking stations, power adapters, and small accessories for new hires across NA, EU, and APAC. High level ask below — could you send a consolidated quote and an SOW with proposed SLAs (customs clearance, lead times, handling exceptions)?

What we need:
- Qty estimate: 450 USB-C docking stations, 650 65W power adapters, 1200 USB-C cables, 300 travel adapters
- Destinations: US (primary), DE/FR/UK (EU), SG/HK (APAC) — multiple delivery addresses per country
- Incoterms preferred: DDP where possible; provide DDU alternate pricing for comparison
- Customs handling: we want a single point of contact for clearance and duties management; highlight any required docs (COO, commercial invoice format)
- Packaging: consolidated pallets to regional hubs + small parcel last-mile to campuses and home addresses
- Lead time targets: non-urgent lanes 10-14 business days door-to-door, expedited lanes 3-5 business days
- Pricing validity: 30 days

Important constraints: many devices will be going directly to new hires' homes (small parcels) — explain how you manage address verification, signature requirements, and returns for DOAs. Also confirm whether you offer consolidation to a single EU hub for VAT handling and whether you can provide monthly invoice aggregation.

Budget information: we will need a rough cost line items to request a PO this week (budget code TBD — I'll loop finance).

Can we get a first-pass quote + SOW by EOD Thu (9/17)? If you prefer, book a 30-min scoping call and include Marcus (facilities) and Ava (logistics).

Thanks,
